title: /.well-known/fact-ray.json
description: What a subject says about itself (kind: subject), or what a counterparty says about a subject (kind: counterparty). The file is served from the issuer's own domain: that is the identity check.

domain.description: the domain this file is served from

node.description: what the claim is about: gamma-ray:indicator/<id>, gamma-ray:provision/<id>, or any node: address of a publication that uses FACT-Ray

about.description: the product or agent, when the subject has several

evidence.description: pages anyone can open; with at least one, the claim is read at R4

role.description: the role that stands behind the claim (for example: CISO, product owner). A role, not a person's contact detail.

configuration.description: counterparty: which configuration is in use

signature.description: optional: a signature over the file made with a key published through pki.sgit.ai
